openwrt_wiki.beschreibung: This is a dual band 802.11ac AC1200 gigabit wireless router. There are four non-detachable antennas and a USB2 port. The RT-AC57U v1 is a rebadged RT-AC1200GU powered by a Mediatek dual core SoC. (Do NOT confused it with any other device with model name beginning RT-AC1200) The RT-AC57U v2 announced in August 2019 uses a Qualcomm SoC. New RT-AC57U v3 appeared on Asus USA website in March 2020.
openwrt_wiki.installation_ssh: Setup-Wizard, SSH in Administration -> System aktivieren, Sysupgrade-Image per scp nach /tmp, mtd-write -i /tmp/owrt.bin -d linux, reboot
openwrt_wiki.installation_tftp: Rechner 192.168.1.75, mit gedrücktem Reset einschalten, nach 5 s loslassen, Sysupgrade-Image per TFTP an 192.168.1.1
openwrt_wiki.asus_rescue_mode: Firmware Restoration Tool, Reset beim Einschalten halten bis Power-LED langsam blinkt, PC 192.168.1.10/24
openwrt_wiki.rueckseite: From Left to Right: Power, On/Off switch, USB2, Reset, WAN, 4x LAN, WPS button. Regular 2.1mm x 5.5mm Barrel plug for 12v DC power.
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: remove the 4 small rubber feet, after the removal we can access to the 4 screws that hold the lid ... hold in place very tightly by little extruded plastic holders ... start by the rear part using a spudger
openwrt_wiki.seriell: Use the TX, RX and Gnd pins. (The +3.3v is not required); 57600, 8N1
openwrt_wiki.foto_seriell: Lötaugen J2, 4 Durchkontaktierungen ohne Stiftleiste, beschriftet von links: RX, TX, Gnd, +3.3v; Pin 1 (+3.3v) rechts neben LED18 (Power-LED)
openwrt_wiki.foto_typenschild: Model: RT-AC57U, Input: 12V 2A, Dual-band Wireless-AC1200 Gigabit Router, F/W Ver.: V3.0.0.4.380_10669, H/W Ver.: A, MAC 40B076..., SN JBIU4900..., SSID ASUS_50_2G / ASUS_50_5G, Default http://router.asus.com admin/admin, CE, EAC, UA.TR.028, Made in China
openwrt_wiki.foto_rueckseite: DC-IN, Ein/Aus-Taster, USB-A, RESET (Loch), WAN blau, 4x LAN gelb, WPS-Taster
openwrt_wiki.hinweise: Jan 2020: Relayd wireless bridge may not work properly with OpenWrt (FS#2816)

openwrt_git_support.LED: Power, LAN {1-4}, WAN, WiFi 2.4 GHz, WiFi 5 GHz, USB
openwrt_git_support.UART: UART is present next to the Power LED. TX - RX - GND - 3V3 / 57600-8N1. 3V3 is the nearest one to the Power LED.

openwrt_image_mk.block:
define Device/asus_rt-ac57u-v1
  $(Device/dsa-migration)
  DEVICE_VENDOR := ASUS
  DEVICE_MODEL := RT-AC57U
  DEVICE_VARIANT := v1
  DEVICE_ALT0_VENDOR := ASUS
  DEVICE_ALT0_MODEL := RT-AC1200GU
  IMAGE_SIZE := 16064k
  DEVICE_PACKAGES := kmod-mt7603 kmod-mt76x2 kmod-usb3 \
	kmod-usb-ledtrig-usbport
  SUPPORTED_DEVICES += asus,rt-ac57u
endef
TARGET_DEVICES += asus_rt-ac57u-v1
